content.short: Unique NFTs with serious utility. Characters based on play on words. Rewards, tooling and gaming for holders.
content.description:
Pun City is a Cardano native NFT collection created by a former IOG employee. Characters are pun-based whether historical, pop culture or sports.

Character collections are limited to 200-400 and have specific text provided for each iteration. Utility includes rewards, such as tokens of our favorite Cardano projects, tooling and gaming.
